name: Dressler Pointed Chelsea Boot
description: A slim-profile chelsea boot with a pointed toe and stacked 4cm heel, elastic gussets in matching synth-leather. Available in matte black and a dark forest green that photographs as black under most lighting. Dressler makes workhorses for people who need to look sharp five days a week without thinking about it. Clean, durable, endlessly versatile.
functionality: Anti-fatigue insole with gel heel cushion. No active tech.
what_it_says: You're put-together and consistent. You've made your choices and you stick with them.
story_hooks: The forest green colorway is popular enough that a specific cohort of corponation employees all wear it — making them easy to identify in a crowd.
A pair found at a crime scene still has a transit chip lodged in the heel — someone hid it there deliberately.
